title: Inspiration of Scripture
definition: The inspiration of Scripture means that God superintended the human authors of the Bible so that what they wrote was truly their own writing and truly the Word of God.
summary: The Bible came through real human authors, languages, histories, personalities, and circumstances, yet the final result is God-breathed Scripture. Inspiration protects the divine origin and trustworthiness of the biblical text.
christFocus: The Scriptures bear witness to Christ, and Christ treated the Scriptures as the Word of God. The inspired Word reveals the incarnate Word, Jesus Christ, who is the center and fulfillment of God's redemptive message.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Inspiration does not mean that the Bible is merely inspiring to read. It means Scripture is breathed out by God. The Holy Spirit carried along the biblical authors so that their writings communicate God's truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: If Scripture is inspired by God, then it is trustworthy, binding, profitable, and necessary. The believer can read the Bible with confidence that God has truly spoken.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach Scripture reverently, prayerfully, and obediently. Do not treat the Bible as common literature only, but as the living Word God uses to teach, correct, train, comfort, and sanctify His people.

sources: B. B. Warfield, The Inspiration and Authority of the Bible
